title: Flaming Fajita Traybake
ingredients: 3 peppers (red, orange and yellow), deseeded and cut into strips
To serve: coriander leaves, lime wedges
steps: Spray base of deep nonstick baking tray; spread onions, peppers and chicken in an even layer.
Sprinkle spice mix over; shuffle to coat. Spray with cooking spray.
Bake 35 minutes until chicken is cooked through and peppers and onions are slightly charred.
Serve with coriander and lime wedges.
notes: Make vegetarian by replacing chicken with butternut squash or sweet potato. Bulk out with drained canned beans (black or pinto) added 5 minutes before end.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
